en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 0.9 percent lower at 23,651 after early gains reverse
en.dek: The benchmark opened higher following Wall Street gains but ended Wednesday down 216 points, with the tech index also falling and CATL leading declines after results.
body: Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index closed 0.90 percent lower at 23,651.87 points on Wednesday, according to exchange data. The index had opened at 24,139 before surrendering gains.

The Hang Seng Tech Index fell 1.26 percent to 3,994.77, while the China Enterprises Index dropped 1.08 percent. Turnover was substantial. Among heavyweights, Tencent declined around 4 percent and CATL fell more than 10 percent after releasing quarterly results. Some financial and property stocks held relatively firmer.
The session followed an earlier open higher that tracked overnight gains in the United States. By midday the index was already lower, and selling pressure continued into the close.

zh.headline: 恒指收跌216點報23651 早段升幅全數回吐
zh.dek: 港股周三高開後轉跌，科技指數同步向下，寧德時代績後急挫逾一成，成交活躍。
body: 恒生指數周三收市報23651.87點，下跌215.87點或0.90%。指數早段高見24139點，其後升幅逐步收窄並轉跌。
恒生科技指數跌1.26%報3994.77點，國企指數亦向下。成交金額龐大。成份股中，騰訊控股跌約4%，寧德時代公布季度業績後急挫逾一成。部分金融及地產股表現相對穩健。
港股早段跟隨美股升勢高開，但中午已轉跌，午後沽壓持續至收市。
